explication: LangBot is a platform for configuring and running AI-powered bots across instant-messaging services. The primary workflow is an incoming platform event, normalized by an adapter, processed through a configured pipeline and its AI/agent capabilities, then answered through the platform. The management API and web panel configure pipelines, integrations, and workspaces; monitoring surfaces runtime activity. The README documents broad provider, knowledge-base, plugin, and MCP capabilities. Some runtime wiring and those subsystems’ implementations were not sampled, so uncertain links are omitted.
